# Polaris

> Constitution and operating framework for how britx (Pedro Henrique Bahia Brito) designs, builds, ships, and maintains software — written to be consumed by AI copilots as guardrails and retrieval context.

Canonical text lives in this repository under `polaris/`. The wiki and website are derived views.

## Constitution (read first)

- [Constitution index](polaris/constitution/README.md): how to read it, the constitution map, the working rule
- [Preamble](polaris/constitution/preamble.md): why Polaris exists
- [Foundations](polaris/constitution/foundations.md): worldview, ontology, epistemology, axiology, ethics
- [Principles](polaris/constitution/principles.md): the ten constitutional principles
- [Engineering Laws](polaris/constitution/engineering-laws.md): principles as operational constraints
- [Derived Frameworks](polaris/constitution/derived-frameworks.md): lifecycle/architecture selection, AI collaboration model, documentation and failure models
- [Reference Implementations](polaris/constitution/reference-implementations.md): templates and heuristics
